Markets.title: Jio IPO: Akash Ambani says Rs 30,213 crore issue will push company towards net debt-free status
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms plans to use its upcoming IPO proceeds of up to Rs 27,500 crore to repay borrowings and become net debt-free. Akash Ambani also highlighted the company's growth opportunities within India's projected $1.4 trillion digital economy by fiscal year 2031.

Markets.title: How Akash, Isha Ambani’s missed college assignment led to the creation of Rs 10 lakh crore Jio
Markets.summary: Akash and Isha Ambani's missed college assignment inspired the creation of Reliance Jio, which is now valued at approximately Rs 10.3 lakh crore. Reliance plans to use the proceeds from Jio's upcoming Rs 30,213 crore IPO to reduce debt and unlock value from its digital business.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Nasdaq futures slide 1% as AI selloff deepens amid debt concerns
Markets.summary: Nasdaq futures declined one percent as the ongoing artificial intelligence selloff deepened. The market downturn was further amplified by mounting concerns regarding debt.

Markets.title: Torrent Power plans around $500 million bond sale, bankers say
Markets.summary: Torrent Power plans to raise about $500 million through a rupee-denominated bond sale to diversify its funding sources. The company intends to use the proceeds to help finance the acquisition of Nabha Power for approximately 69 billion rupees.

Markets.title: Why are credit default swaps unnerving AI investors?
Markets.summary: The cost to insure against US tech defaults has reached record highs due to growing credit stress in the AI sector. This anxiety is especially focused on data centers that rely on future revenue.

Markets.title: Tech Mahindra Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 33% YoY to Rs 1,586 crore; co declares Rs 15/share dividend, 1:1 bonus issue
Markets.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a 33% year-over-year increase in net profit to Rs 1,586 crore for the second quarter. The company's board declared an interim dividend of Rs 15 per share and approved a 1:1 bonus issue.

Geo-Political.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of launching a drone attack on a Russian oil refinery. The incident follows Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's announcement that strikes on energy infrastructure would resume in response to recent Russian attacks.

Geo-Political.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
Geo-Political.summary: At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed when a school roof collapsed in the north-western Pakistani city of Peshawar. Rescue officials fear additional people remain buried beneath the debris.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead in Istanbul after heaviest rainfall in 84 years, governor says
Geo-Political.summary: Istanbul experienced its heaviest rainfall in 84 years, resulting in two deaths. Authorities have advised residents to stay indoors unless strictly necessary.

Geo-Political.title: Eight crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
Geo-Political.summary: A search and rescue operation is underway in the Black Sea after a drone attack set a tanker ablaze off Romania's coast. Eight crew members are currently missing following the incident.

Geo-Political.title: White House defends new press secretary amid questions about her legal credentials
Geo-Political.summary: The White House defended new press secretary Katie Zacharia following questions about her qualifications. Reports indicate that Zacharia is not registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
Geo-Political.summary: Brazil's Congress has approved a shorter working week, giving a political victory to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. His supporters hope this measure will increase his popularity before the upcoming presidential run-off in 10 days.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 used across various industries to drive innovation and efficiency. These advanced solutions are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and boost overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create efficient, engaging, and relevant content for their audiences.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money using the platform. It also outlines top CJ affiliate programs and lists alternative platforms for users.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections up 13.2% at  ₹13.38 tn, corporate tax buoys
Data & Insights.summary: India's net direct tax collections rose 13.2% to ₹13.38 trillion. This growth was primarily driven by strong corporate tax collections.

Data & Insights.title: IMF backs India's revised GDP methodology, projects it to overtake Japan as 4th-largest economy in 2027
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF endorsed India's revised GDP methodology and projects the country will overtake Japan to become the world's fourth-largest economy in 2027 with a nominal GDP of $4.52 trillion. Driven by this revised approach, the fund raised India's 2026 growth forecast to 7%, compared to a projected 0.7% growth for Japan.

Data & Insights.title: India's merchandise trade deficit widens to $30.21 billion in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise exports rose to $44.40 billion in September while imports increased to $74.61 billion. Consequently, the country's merchandise trade deficit widened to $30.21 billion during the month.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What do the GST Council’s latest tax cuts mean for India’s farmers?
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council has introduced tax exemptions and lower rates for seed storage, coffee curing, retreaded tyres, and psyllium seeds. These changes aim to reduce operational gaps and lower supply chain costs for farmers.

Data & Insights.title: India Inc employee attrition rises to 18% in 2026; AI is changing how companies manage talent, shows new study
Data & Insights.summary: Employee attrition in Indian companies increased from 16.2% in 2025 to 18% in 2026 despite stable salary budgets. A new study shows that artificial intelligence is also transforming how organizations manage their talent.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Board of directors is expanding’: Jaishankar pitches bigger role for ‘middle powers’ in changing global order
Data & Insights.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for an expanded global role for "middle powers" to help navigate a changing international order. This follows a similar proposal earlier this year by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney for middle powers to unite as the US-led rules-based order declines.

India.title: Delhi High Court Refuses To Stop Tomorrow's CJP Protest At Connaught Place. Police To 'Regulate'
India.summary: The Delhi High Court has refused to stop a planned protest at Connaught Place called by Abhijeet Dipke regarding alleged electoral fraud. Police will regulate the gathering, where participants have been asked to bring the national flag.

India.title: Jharkhand TET Admit Card 2026 Out: Download Hall Ticket, Check Exam Date
India.summary: The Jharkhand TET 2026 admit cards are now available for online download. The examination is scheduled to take place on November 1.

India.title: Bar Council Of India Releases AIBE 22 Syllabus, Check Subject-Wise Weightage
India.summary: The Bar Council of India has released the syllabus and subject-wise weightage for the AIBE 22 exam. Scheduled for November 29, 2026, the test will cover subjects including constitutional law, criminal law, and professional ethics.

India.title: 'Will Return Money': Video Emerges Of Lucknow Man Who Fell From Influencer's Flat
India.summary: A video has emerged of Shiva Sharma promising to return money before he fell to his death from social media influencer Shraddha Dubey's Lucknow flat. Sharma's family has accused Dubey of murdering him.

India.title: "Shows Character": BJP Attacks Rahul Gandhi For 'Misbehaving' With Woman Cop
India.summary: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi for allegedly touching a woman police officer inappropriately. A BJP spokesperson stated that women police officers deserve the same dignity as protesters.

India.title: Train Hits 3-Foot-Long Iron Bar Placed On Gujarat Tracks, Case Filed
India.summary: Unidentified individuals placed a three-foot-long iron bar on the railway tracks in Gujarat. A train struck the metallic object, prompting authorities to file a formal case.

General.title: Man killed by tiger climbed two fences before suffering multiple injuries, inquest hears
General.summary: An inquest heard that William Chapman died after climbing two fences to enter a tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park. He suffered multiple injuries during the attack.

General.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
General.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery following fresh Russian strikes. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that a previous pause on striking energy sites is now over.

General.title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
General.summary: The UK home secretary threatened to ban Eritreans due to their government's refusal to cooperate with migrant returns. She stated she will not hesitate to impose similar measures on other uncooperative countries.

General.title: Watch: Swimmer's emotional TV plea for cancer research leads to meeting with PM
General.summary: Scottish swimmer Archie Goodburn, who has three inoperable brain tumours, made a television appeal for increased cancer research funding. His plea led to a meeting with politician Andy Burnham.

General.title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
General.summary: A severe drought has been declared in parts of southern England due to dropping reservoir levels. This situation was caused by a hot summer and below-average rainfall in September.

General.title: Watch: Harry and Meghan at first joint engagement since UK return
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are making several public appearances together in Nottingham. This marks their first joint public engagement since returning to the UK.
